items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: The name 'Bill' appears exclusively as a form of address to the interviewer (e.g., 'it just clicked, Bill', 'fabulous thing, Bill', 'naturally left handed Bill'). There is no mention of a person named Bill Russell in the interviewee's narrative.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, the pianist. He was from New York, I guess.

Yes, and Johnny Castang. Yeah. And they didn't expect any big things to happen, but it just clicked, Bill. From then on he went into the band business. From then on, in fact, we made him enough money to build the new Knicks.
That place across the street, yeah.
